items.text: Three days left; you need an AI or domain co-lead and your research office's internal sign-off.

items.title: Horizon wave and tidal call opens 3 Dec
items.text: One €43m Innovation Action, closing 31 March; consortia are forming now.

items.title: Neural spectral wave model transfers zero-shot across ocean basins
items.text: Trained only on the South China Sea, it reaches about 96% of a numerical model's accuracy elsewhere, at a fraction of the cost.

items.title: Telling plunging from spilling breakers by sound
items.text: Hydrophone tests show plungers give short, intense low-frequency bursts, distinct from spillers; total acoustic energy tracks dissipation poorly.
